name: de-slop-vscode
description: Anti AI-slop diagnostics in the editor: code slop, accessibility, prose, agent instructions, and MCP configs

de-slop.scanOnSave.description: Scan a file with de-slop when it is saved.

de-slop.scanOnType.description: Scan while typing. Off by default: the scanner parses an AST on every change.

de-slop.checkAgentInstructions.description: Check agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules) against the workspace for stale paths, symbols, and scripts. Reads source files once and caches the result.
